# A Witness for the History

*Petronella's secret history needs a witness, not a letter. See the old towpath bend on the Long Reach Banks, deal with the crabs, and tell Melisende what you saw.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the old towpath bend in [The Long Reach Banks](../maps/reach_banks.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Bank Lorang](../monsters/bank_lorang.md)
3. Talk to [Melisende](../npcs/melisende.md)

## Rewards

- 16,800 EXP
- 700 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x15
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +120 standing with [Petronella](../npcs/petronella.md)
